title: When the Letters Burns
author: R. M. Marchetti
blurb: Wendell Oyelaran, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
